dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Everyone looks so happy... The experience is different from gazing at the starry sky, but still... what a sight to behold.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you. Layla got a burst of energy after talking with you. She managed to finish her paper before the Festival without sleepwalking even once. But, she crashed as soon as it was submitted.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: I saw her write this in the acknowledgement section...

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: "Interactions between stars can lend immense strength to involved bodies, to the point where they can even alter preexisting orbits..."

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: "Real life mirrors astronomy in this way. You never know what miracles can be achieved when two people seem to resonate at the same frequency. This author speaks from personal experience."

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: As for me... I'll take a picture to capture this moment and put it on her desk.
